title: Cauchy's theorem for a finite field-automorphism group
statement: Let $L/K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $H$ be a finite subgroup of the group of $K$-algebra automorphisms of $L$, with composition as multiplication. If $q$ is a prime natural number dividing $|H|$, then there exists $h\in H$ whose order is exactly $q$; the order of $h$ means the least positive integer $m$ with $h^m=1$.
